objective: Add --repeat <n> and --json, composing with --shout, preserving existing behavior except the compatibility changes explicitly authorized by Q-003, and add tests.

requirements.text: --repeat <n> emits the greeting n times, defaulting to one emission.

acceptance.text: --repeat 3 Ada exits 0 with stdout exactly Hello, Ada! followed by newline three times, and empty stderr.
--repeat 1 Ada exits 0 with stdout exactly 'Hello, Ada!\n' and empty stderr.
--repeat=2 Ada exits 0 with stdout exactly 'Hello, Ada!\nHello, Ada!\n' and empty stderr.

requirements.text: Missing or invalid repeat values fail before greeting output with exit 2 and usage.

acceptance.text: --repeat 0 Ada exits 2 with empty stdout and exactly USAGE plus newline on stderr.
Separate repeat-value cases for -1, abc, 1.5, empty string, 1e3 and 9007199254740992 exit 2 with empty stdout and exactly USAGE plus newline on stderr.
--repeat Ada, Ada --repeat and --repeat --json Ada each exit 2 with empty stdout and exactly USAGE plus newline on stderr.

requirements.text: --json emits a compact object containing the greeting string instead of plain greeting text.

acceptance.text: --json Ada exits 0 with stdout exactly '{"greeting":"Hello, Ada!"}\n' and empty stderr.
Names containing quotes, backslashes, newline and tab produce valid JSON whose greeting equals greet(name), with one physical line per emission; serializer unit tests additionally cover NUL.

requirements.text: Repeat and JSON compose with shout and each other; options are recognized before or after the name as authorized by Q-003.

acceptance.text: --shout --json Ada exits 0 with stdout exactly '{"greeting":"HELLO, ADA!"}\n' and empty stderr.
--shout --repeat 2 Ada exits 0 with stdout exactly 'HELLO, ADA!\nHELLO, ADA!\n' and empty stderr.
--json --repeat 2 --shout Ada emits exactly two compact shouted greeting object lines; --json --repeat 2 Ada emits exactly two compact unshouted greeting object lines. Both exit 0 with empty stderr.

Table-driven CLI cases place options before, after and around the name, including Ada --json --shout and Ada --repeat 2 --json --shout, and assert results equal their corresponding options-first invocations.

requirements.text: Preserve greeting, shout and no-name behavior, with only the compatibility changes authorized by Q-003.

acceptance.text: Ada exits 0 with stdout exactly 'Hello, Ada!\n' and empty stderr.
--shout Ada exits 0 with stdout exactly 'HELLO, ADA!\n' and empty stderr.
No arguments, --shout alone, --json alone, --repeat 2 without a name, and an empty first name exit 2 with empty stdout and exactly USAGE plus newline on stderr.
Existing greet and shout cases remain passing; greet(name) and shout(text) implementations remain unchanged.
Ada extra still greets Ada once; Ada --shout now shouts as authorized; usage is exactly 'Usage: node bin/hello.js [--shout] [--json] [--repeat <n>] <name>'.

requirements.text: Reject unknown options with exit 2 and usage, as authorized by Q-003.

acceptance.text: --verbose Ada, Ada --verbose and malformed boolean assignments such as --json=true Ada each exit 2 with empty stdout and exactly USAGE plus newline on stderr.

decisions.title: Parser contract and approved compatibility
decisions.decision: T1 owns parseCliArgs(argv) and USAGE in src/args.js. Apply the supplied Q-003 answer: reject unknown options and recognize options before or after the name. Use strict dependency-free parsing with positional support and per-occurrence validation. Repeat defaults to 1; require decimal digits and a positive safe integer; accept leading zeros and equals syntax; validate every occurrence and use the last valid count. Duplicate booleans are idempotent. Respect --. Use the first positional name and ignore extras; missing/empty first names fail. Return the documented structured success/failure contract.

decisions.title: JSON formatting
decisions.decision: T2 adds toJson(text) = JSON.stringify({greeting:text}); preserve shout(text). Shout before serializing. Default to compact JSON and one object per repetition.

decisions.title: CLI process effects
decisions.decision: T3 validates before stdout output. Failure prints USAGE once to stderr and sets exitCode 2. Success computes greeting, optional shout, optional JSON, then emits using a repeat loop without a repeated-output array or full repeated string.

decisions.title: Authorized usage update
decisions.decision: Q-003 authorizes USAGE = 'Usage: node bin/hello.js [--shout] [--json] [--repeat <n>] <name>'. Update existing exact usage assertions accordingly.

decisions.title: Verification boundary
decisions.decision: Retain node:test, strict assertions and spawnSync CLI tests. Add parser and serializer unit tests and mapped CLI cases. npm test is the sole proposed future executable check. Inspect changed test commands before execution. No checks are authorized or executed in this planning attempt; no browser work or direct CLI spot probes.
